CREATE OR ALTER VIEW gold.calendar
AS
SELECT *
FROM OPENROWSET(
    BULK 'https://swap01storageaccount.blob.core.windows.net/silver/AdventureWorks_Calendar/',
    FORMAT = 'PARQUET'
) AS CalendarView;
GO
